title: Person-by-Person Greek Mythological & Heroic Stemmata (Apollodorus & Hesiod)

nodes.name: Pontus, Phorcys, Ceto & Nereus (Greek Sea Cosmogony)
nodes.notes: Pontus + Gaia -> Phorcys & Ceto (-> Graiae & Gorgon Medusa) and Nereus + Doris -> 50 Nereids (including Thetis, mother of Achilles).

nodes.name: Hyperion, Coeus, Crius & Titan House (Hesiod / Apollodorus I.ii)
nodes.notes: Unites Hyperion/Theia (-> Helios, Selene, Eos), Coeus/Phoebe (-> Leto, Asteria), and Crius (-> Perses -> Hecate).

nodes.name: Calliope & the Nine Muses (Zeus + Mnemosyne, Hesiod Theog. 53–920)
nodes.notes: Calliope (+ Oeagrus/Apollo) -> Orpheus & Linus; Zeus + Themis -> Horae & Fates.

nodes.name: Calyce (Daughter of Aeolus; Ancestress of Aetolia, Apollodorus I.vii.5)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Aeolus who bore Endymion -> Aetolus -> Oeneus -> Meleager, Deianira & Tydeus -> Diomedes.

nodes.name: Enipeus / Tyro Pylos-Iolcus Lineage Anchor (Apollodorus I.ix.8)
nodes.notes: Salmoneus's daughter Tyro bore Pelias of Iolcus and Neleus of Pylos (-> wise King Nestor).

nodes.name: Cretheid House of Iolcus & Argonauts Anchor (Apollodorus I.ix.11–28)
nodes.notes: Cretheus's sons Aeson (-> Jason), Pheres (-> Admetus), and Amythaon (-> Melampus & Bias -> Adrastus).

nodes.name: Glaucus of Corinth (Son of Sisyphus; Father of Bellerophon, Apollodorus I.ix.3)
nodes.notes: Son of Sisyphus & Merope; father of Bellerophon.

nodes.name: Danaid Survival Line Anchor (Hypermnestra & Lynceus, Apollodorus II.i.5)
nodes.notes: Hypermnestra spared Lynceus, continuing the Argive royal stem to Abas -> Acrisius & Proetus.

nodes.name: Perseid Royal Line Anchor (Mycenae & Tiryns, Apollodorus II.iv.5)
nodes.notes: Connects Perseus & Andromeda to Alcaeus, Sthenelus, and Electryon (-> Alcmene -> Heracles).

nodes.name: Heraclid Cleodaeus → Aristomachus (Return of the Heraclidae Anchor, c. 1104 BCE)
nodes.role: Dorian Conquest & Return of the Heraclidae
nodes.notes: Hyllus's son Cleodaeus -> Aristomachus, whose sons Temenus (Argos), Cresphontes (Messene) & Aristodemus (Sparta) led the Dorian return.

nodes.name: Cretan House of Minos Anchor (Catreus & Deucalion, Apollodorus III.i–iii)
nodes.role: Cretan Royal Bridge to Atreids & Athens
nodes.notes: Minos + Pasiphae -> Catreus (-> Aerope), Deucalion (-> Idomeneus), Ariadne, and Phaedra.

nodes.name: Cadmean Labdacid House of Thebes Anchor (Apollodorus III.iv–vii)
nodes.notes: Cadmus & Harmonia -> Semele (-> Dionysus), Illyrius, and Polydorus -> Labdacus -> Laius -> Oedipus -> Eteocles, Polynices, Antigone.

nodes.name: Aleus & Auge of Arcadia (Ancestors of Telephus of Mysia, Apollodorus III.ix)
nodes.role: Arcadian Pelasgid Bridge to Heracles & Mysia
nodes.notes: Arcas -> Aleus -> Princess Auge (+ Heracles -> King Telephus of Mysia).

nodes.name: Pleiades Maia & Taygete (Ancestresses of Hermes & Sparta, Apollodorus III.x)
nodes.notes: Daughters of Atlas & Pleione: Maia -> Hermes; Taygete -> Lacedaemon -> Tyndareus & Icarius.

nodes.name: Asopus & Aegina (Aeacid Ancestors of Achilles, Ajax & Alexander, Apollodorus III.xii)
nodes.notes: River god Asopus -> Aegina -> King Aeacus -> Telamon (Ajax & Teucer) and Peleus (Achilles -> Neoptolemus -> Olympias -> Alexander!).

nodes.name: Erichthonius & Pandion I (Early Kings of Athens Anchor, Apollodorus III.xiv)
nodes.notes: Cecrops -> Erichthonius -> Pandion I -> Erechtheus -> Pandion II -> Aegeus -> Theseus.

nodes.name: House of Atreus Anchor (Pelopids of Mycenae, Apollodorus Epit. II–VI)
nodes.notes: Tantalus -> Pelops -> Atreus/Thyestes/Pittheus -> Agamemnon/Menelaus -> Orestes.

nodes.name: Hestia (Eldest Olympian, Daughter of Cronus & Rhea)
nodes.notes: Hestia (Eldest Olympian, Daughter of Cronus & Rhea).

nodes.name: Demeter (Goddess of Harvest, Daughter of Cronus & Rhea)
nodes.notes: Demeter (Goddess of Harvest, Daughter of Cronus & Rhea).

nodes.name: Hera (Queen of Olympus, Daughter of Cronus & Rhea)
nodes.notes: Hera (Queen of Olympus, Daughter of Cronus & Rhea).

nodes.name: Hades / Pluto (Lord of Underworld, Son of Cronus & Rhea)
nodes.notes: Hades / Pluto (Lord of Underworld, Son of Cronus & Rhea).

nodes.name: Poseidon (Lord of the Sea, Son of Cronus & Rhea)
nodes.notes: Poseidon (Lord of the Sea, Son of Cronus & Rhea).

nodes.name: Athena (Goddess of Wisdom, Daughter of Zeus & Metis)
nodes.notes: Athena (Goddess of Wisdom, Daughter of Zeus & Metis).

nodes.name: Apollo (God of Light & Prophecy, Son of Zeus & Leto)
nodes.notes: Apollo (God of Light & Prophecy, Son of Zeus & Leto).

nodes.name: Artemis (Twin of Apollo; Goddess of the Hunt, Zeus & Leto)
nodes.notes: Artemis (Twin of Apollo; Goddess of the Hunt, Zeus & Leto).

nodes.name: Aphrodite (Goddess of Love; Mother of Aeneas, Hesiod Theog. 190)
nodes.notes: Aphrodite (Goddess of Love; Mother of Aeneas, Hesiod Theog. 190).

nodes.name: Ares (God of War; Son of Zeus & Hera; Father of Harmonia)
nodes.notes: Ares (God of War; Son of Zeus & Hera; Father of Harmonia).

nodes.name: Hephaestus (Divine Smith; Son of Hera & Zeus)
nodes.notes: Hephaestus (Divine Smith; Son of Hera & Zeus).

nodes.name: Persephone (Queen of Underworld; Daughter of Zeus & Demeter)
nodes.notes: Persephone (Queen of Underworld; Daughter of Zeus & Demeter).

nodes.name: Orpheus (Thracian Singer & Argonaut, Son of Calliope)
nodes.notes: Orpheus (Thracian Singer & Argonaut, Son of Calliope).

nodes.name: Helios (Sun Titan; Son of Hyperion & Theia; Father of Aeetes)
nodes.notes: Helios (Sun Titan; Son of Hyperion & Theia; Father of Aeetes).

nodes.name: Selene (Moon Titaness; Daughter of Hyperion & Theia)
nodes.notes: Selene (Moon Titaness; Daughter of Hyperion & Theia).

nodes.name: Eos (Dawn Titaness; Mother of Memnon, Hyperion & Theia)
nodes.notes: Eos (Dawn Titaness; Mother of Memnon, Hyperion & Theia).

nodes.name: Hecate (Daughter of Perses & Asteria, Hesiod Theog. 411)
nodes.notes: Hecate (Daughter of Perses & Asteria, Hesiod Theog. 411).

nodes.name: Chiron the Wise Centaur (Son of Cronus & Philyra; Tutor of Achilles)
nodes.notes: Chiron the Wise Centaur (Son of Cronus & Philyra; Tutor of Achilles).

nodes.name: Medusa (Mortal Gorgon; Daughter of Phorcys & Ceto)
nodes.notes: Medusa (Mortal Gorgon; Daughter of Phorcys & Ceto).

nodes.name: Pegasus (Winged Steed Sprung From Medusa & Poseidon)
nodes.notes: Pegasus (Winged Steed Sprung From Medusa & Poseidon).

nodes.name: King Endymion of Elis (Son of Aethlius & Calyce)
nodes.notes: Son of Calyce (dau. of Aeolus) & Aethlius; father of Aetolus.

nodes.name: King Aetolus (Son of Endymion; Eponym of Aetolia)
nodes.notes: Son of Endymion; father of Pleuron & Calydon (-> Oeneus).

nodes.name: King Oeneus of Calydon (Father of Meleager, Deianira & Tydeus)
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Aetolus; father of Meleager, Deianira (wife of Heracles), and Tydeus.

nodes.name: Meleager (Hero of Calydonian Boar Hunt, Son of Oeneus & Althaea)
nodes.notes: Slew the Calydonian Boar alongside Atalanta.

nodes.name: Deianira (Daughter of Oeneus; Last Mortal Wife of Heracles)
nodes.role: Princess of Calydon & Mother of Hyllus
nodes.notes: Married Heracles and bore Hyllus, ancestor of the Dorian Heraclidae & Spartan kings.

nodes.name: Tydeus (Son of Oeneus; Hero of Seven Against Thebes)
nodes.notes: Wed Deipyle (daughter of Adrastus of Argos) and fathered Diomedes.

nodes.name: King Diomedes of Argos (Son of Tydeus; Iliad & Epigoni Hero)
nodes.notes: Led 80 Argive ships to Troy; succeeded maternal grandfather Adrastus.

nodes.name: Phrixus (Son of Athamas; Carrier of the Golden Fleece to Colchis)
nodes.role: Aeolid Prince Carried by the Golden Ram
nodes.notes: Fled to King Aeetes in Colchis, marrying Chalciope and bequeathing the Golden Fleece.

nodes.name: Helle (Daughter of Athamas; Eponym of the Hellespont)
nodes.notes: Twin sister of Phrixus who fell into the strait named Hellespont.

nodes.name: Bellerophon (Son of Glaucus; Slayer of the Chimera)
nodes.notes: Son of Glaucus of Corinth; slew the Chimera in Lycia; grandfather of Glaucus & Sarpedon.

nodes.name: Tyro (Daughter of Salmoneus; Mother of Pelias, Neleus & Aeson)
nodes.notes: Bore twins Pelias & Neleus by Poseidon, and Aeson, Pheres & Amythaon by Cretheus.

nodes.name: King Pelias of Iolcus (Half-Brother of Aeson; Opponent of Jason)
nodes.notes: Sent nephew Jason for the Golden Fleece; father of Alcestis & Acastus.

nodes.name: King Neleus of Pylos (+ Chloris; Father of Nestor)
nodes.role: Founder of Neleid Dynasty of Pylos
nodes.notes: Father of 12 sons, of whom youngest Nestor survived to rule Pylos.

nodes.name: King Nestor of Pylos (Wise Counselor of the Iliad, Son of Neleus)
nodes.role: Aged Counselor of Greeks at Troy
nodes.notes: Wise elder king of Pylos; father of Antilochus & Pisistratus.

nodes.name: Aeson (Eldest Son of Cretheus & Tyro; Father of Jason)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Cretheus; entrusted infant Jason to Centaur Chiron.

nodes.name: Jason (Leader of the Argonauts, Son of Aeson)
nodes.role: Captain of the Argo & Winner of the Golden Fleece
nodes.notes: Led the 50 Argonauts to Colchis and married Princess Medea.

nodes.name: Medea of Colchis (Daughter of King Aeetes; Granddaughter of Helios)
nodes.notes: Daughter of King Aeetes of Colchis; bore Medus/Medeus (mythic Greek eponym of the Medes).

nodes.name: Melampus the Seer (Son of Amythaon; King of Argos, Apollodorus I.ix.11)
nodes.notes: Cured Proetus's daughters and received a third of Argos; ancestor of Amphiaraus.

nodes.name: Amphiaraus the Seer (Argonaut & Seven Against Thebes; Descendant of Melampus)
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Melampus; married Eriphyle (sister of Adrastus) and fathered Epigoni leader Alcmaeon.

nodes.name: King Adrastus of Argos (Son of Talaus; Leader of Seven Against Thebes)
nodes.role: Argive Leader of the Seven Against Thebes
nodes.notes: Grandson of Bias (brother of Melampus); survived the expedition on winged horse Arion.

nodes.name: King Admetus of Pherae (Son of Pheres; Husband of Alcestis)
nodes.role: Aeolid King of Pherae in Thessaly
nodes.notes: Served by Apollo for a year; wed Princess Alcestis.

nodes.name: Queen Alcestis (Daughter of Pelias; Wife of Admetus)
nodes.role: Devoted Queen Rescued From Hades by Heracles
nodes.notes: Gave her life for husband Admetus before Heracles restored her from the underworld.

nodes.name: King Phoroneus of Argos (Son of Inachus; First Man of Greece)
nodes.notes: Son of Inachus; father of Niobe (mother of Argus & Pelasgus).

nodes.name: Argus Panoptes (All-Seeing Descendant of Niobe & Phoroneus)
nodes.notes: All-seeing Argive hero slain by Hermes.

nodes.name: Hypermnestra (Eldest Danaid Who Spared Her Husband)
nodes.notes: Sole Danaid to spare Lynceus; mother of Abas.

nodes.name: King Lynceus of Argos (Son of Aegyptus; Husband of Hypermnestra)
nodes.notes: Son of Aegyptus; wed Hypermnestra and founded the later Argive dynasty.

nodes.name: King Abas of Argos (Son of Lynceus & Hypermnestra)
nodes.role: Father of Twin Kings Acrisius & Proetus
nodes.notes: Father of Acrisius of Argos and Proetus of Tiryns.

nodes.name: King Acrisius of Argos (Father of Danaë)
nodes.role: Twin Son of Abas & King of Argos
nodes.notes: Father of Danaë; accidentally slain at Larissa by grandson Perseus.

nodes.name: King Proetus of Tiryns (Twin Brother of Acrisius)
nodes.role: King of Tiryns & Builder of Cyclopean Walls
nodes.notes: Twin brother of Acrisius; shared Argos with Melampus & Bias.

nodes.name: Princess Danaë of Argos (Daughter of Acrisius; Mother of Perseus)
nodes.notes: Placed in a wooden chest with infant Perseus and washed ashore at Seriphos.

nodes.name: Princess Alcmene of Mycenae (Daughter of Electryon; Mother of Heracles)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Electryon (son of Perseus); bore Heracles by Zeus and twin Iphicles by Amphitryon.

nodes.name: Prince Amphitryon (Son of Alcaeus; Stepfather of Heracles)
nodes.notes: Son of Alcaeus (son of Perseus); husband of Alcmene and biological father of Iphicles.

nodes.name: Iphicles (Twin Brother of Heracles; Father of Iolaus)
nodes.notes: Son of Amphitryon & Alcmene; father of Heracles's charioteer Iolaus.

nodes.name: King Eurystheus of Mycenae (Son of Sthenelus; Imposer of 12 Labors)
nodes.notes: Grandson of Perseus via Sthenelus & Nicippe; ordered Heracles's Twelve Labors.

nodes.name: Hyllus (Eldest Son of Heracles & Deianira; Forefather of Spartan Kings)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Heracles & Deianira; wed Iole; ancestor of Cleodaeus -> Aristomachus -> Temenus & Aristodemus.

nodes.name: King Telephus of Mysia (Son of Heracles & Auge)
nodes.notes: Son of Heracles & Arcadian princess Auge; healed by Achilles's spear rust before Troy.

nodes.name: King Temenus of Argos (Great-Great-Grandson of Heracles; Ancestor of Macedon!)
nodes.role: Heraclid Conqueror of Argos & Founder of Argead Line
nodes.notes: Dorian Heraclid king of Argos from whom Alexander the Great's Argead house traced descent.

nodes.name: King Cresphontes of Messene (Brother of Temenus & Aristodemus)
nodes.notes: Drew Messene by lot alongside brothers Temenus and Aristodemus.

nodes.name: Aristodemus (Heraclid Father of Spartan Twin Kings)
nodes.role: Father of Eurysthenes & Procles of Sparta
nodes.notes: Married Argia and sired twins Eurysthenes & Procles, founding Sparta's dual kingship.

nodes.name: King Eurysthenes (Founder of Agiad Dynasty of Sparta — Line of Leonidas!)
nodes.notes: Elder twin son of Aristodemus; forefather of Agis I, Leonidas I & Areus I.

nodes.name: King Procles (Founder of Eurypontid Dynasty of Sparta — Line of Agesilaus II!)
nodes.notes: Younger twin son of Aristodemus; forefather of Lycurgan-era Charilaus & Agesilaus II.

nodes.name: Queen Pasiphaë of Crete (Daughter of Helios; Wife of Minos)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Sun Titan Helios; wife of King Minos.

nodes.name: Asterion / The Minotaur (Born to Pasiphaë, Apollodorus III.i.4)
nodes.notes: Housed in Daedalus's Knossos Labyrinth until slain by Theseus.

nodes.name: Princess Ariadne of Crete (Daughter of Minos & Pasiphaë; Wife of Dionysus)
nodes.notes: Gave Theseus the thread to escape the Labyrinth; wed Dionysus at Naxos.

nodes.name: Queen Phaedra of Athens (Daughter of Minos & Pasiphaë; Wife of Theseus)
nodes.notes: Younger sister of Ariadne; wed Theseus and bore Acamas & Demophon.

nodes.name: King Idomeneus of Crete (Son of Deucalion; Trojan War Commander)
nodes.role: Cretan Leader of 80 Ships at Troy
nodes.notes: Grandson of Minos via Deucalion.

nodes.name: Princess Semele of Thebes (Daughter of Cadmus; Mother of Dionysus)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Cadmus & Harmonia; bore Dionysus by Zeus.

nodes.name: Dionysus (God of Wine & Ecstasy, Son of Zeus & Semele)
nodes.notes: Became an Olympian god and husband of Cretan princess Ariadne.

nodes.name: King Polydorus of Thebes (Son of Cadmus & Harmonia)
nodes.notes: Son of Cadmus; father of Labdacus.

nodes.name: King Labdacus of Thebes (Son of Polydorus)
nodes.notes: Father of King Laius.

nodes.name: King Laius of Thebes (Son of Labdacus; Husband of Jocasta)
nodes.notes: Wed Jocasta (Epicaste), daughter of Menoeceus.

nodes.name: King Oedipus of Thebes (Son of Laius & Jocasta; Solver of the Sphinx)
nodes.notes: Solved the Sphinx's riddle and fathered Eteocles, Polynices, Antigone & Ismene.

nodes.name: King Eteocles of Thebes (Elder Son of Oedipus)
nodes.role: Defender of Thebes Against the Seven
nodes.notes: Fell in single combat against brother Polynices at the Seventh Gate.

nodes.name: Polynices of Thebes (Younger Son of Oedipus; Initiator of Seven Against Thebes)
nodes.notes: Wed Argeia (daughter of Adrastus) and marched with the Seven.

nodes.name: Antigone (Daughter of Oedipus Who Buried Polynices)
nodes.notes: Defied King Creon's decree to bury brother Polynices.

nodes.name: Ismene (Younger Daughter of Oedipus)
nodes.notes: Younger sister of Antigone.

nodes.name: Illyrius (Youngest Son of Cadmus; Eponym of Illyria)
nodes.notes: Born in Encheleia / Illyria in Cadmus's old age.

nodes.name: Alcmaeon (Son of Amphiaraus; Leader of the Epigoni)
nodes.role: Conqueror of Thebes With the Epigoni
nodes.notes: Led the sons of the Seven to capture Thebes a decade later.

nodes.name: King Pelasgus of Arcadia (Autochthonous Progenitor / Son of Niobe)
nodes.notes: Father of Lycaon in Arcadia.

nodes.name: King Lycaon of Arcadia (Father of 50 Sons & Callisto)
nodes.notes: Struck down before Deucalion's Flood; father of Callisto.

nodes.name: Callisto (Daughter of Lycaon; Constellation Ursa Major)
nodes.notes: Bore Arcas to Zeus.

nodes.name: King Arcas of Arcadia (Son of Callisto; Eponym of Arcadia)
nodes.notes: Father of Elatus, Aphidas (-> Aleus) & Azan.

nodes.name: Atalanta of Arcadia (Daughter of Iasus; Huntress & Argonaut)
nodes.role: Virgin Huntress of the Calydonian Boar
nodes.notes: Descendant of Arcas via Clymene; mother of Parthenopaeus.

nodes.name: King Lacedaemon (Son of Zeus & Taygete; Eponym of Sparta)
nodes.notes: Married Sparta (daughter of Eurotas) and named the kingdom after himself & his queen.

nodes.name: Queen Sparta (Daughter of River Eurotas; Eponym of City of Sparta)
nodes.notes: Wife of Lacedaemon; mother of Amyclas & Eurydice (wife of Acrisius!).

nodes.name: King Tyndareus of Sparta (Descendant of Lacedaemon; Husband of Leda)
nodes.role: Spartan King & Stepfather of Helen & Dioscuri
nodes.notes: Brother of Icarius; wed Aetolian princess Leda.

nodes.name: Queen Leda of Sparta (Daughter of Thestius; Mother of Helen, Clytemnestra, Castor & Pollux)
nodes.notes: Mother of Castor, Pollux, Helen & Clytemnestra.

nodes.name: Helen of Sparta / Troy (Daughter of Zeus & Leda; Consort of Menelaus & Paris)
nodes.role: Queen of Sparta Whose Abduction Sparked the Trojan War
nodes.notes: Sister of Clytemnestra, Castor & Pollux; married Menelaus.

nodes.name: Queen Clytemnestra of Mycenae (Daughter of Tyndareus & Leda; Wife of Agamemnon)
nodes.notes: Mother of Orestes, Electra & Iphigenia.

nodes.name: Castor (Dioscuri Twin, Son of Tyndareus & Leda)
nodes.notes: Twin brother of Pollux, celebrated among the Argonauts.

nodes.name: Pollux / Polydeuces (Dioscuri Immortal Boxer, Son of Zeus & Leda)
nodes.notes: Boxer-twin of Castor who shared immortality between Olympus and Hades.

nodes.name: Queen Penelope of Ithaca (Daughter of Icarius of Sparta; Wife of Odysseus)
nodes.role: Faithful Queen of Ithaca & Cousin of Helen
nodes.notes: Daughter of Spartan prince Icarius; bore Telemachus to Odysseus.

nodes.name: Asclepius (God of Medicine, Son of Apollo & Arsinoe/Coronis)
nodes.notes: Taught medicine by Chiron; father of physicians Machaon & Podalirius at Troy.

nodes.name: King Aeacus of Aegina (Son of Zeus & Aegina; Father of Telamon & Peleus)
nodes.notes: Ancestor of Achilles, Ajax & Alexander the Great.

nodes.name: King Telamon of Salamis (Son of Aeacus; Argonaut & Father of Ajax)
nodes.role: King of Salamis & Companion of Heracles
nodes.notes: Fathered Ajax the Great (by Periboea) and Teucer (by Trojan princess Hesione!).

nodes.name: Ajax the Great (Telamonian Bulwark of the Achaeans at Troy)
nodes.notes: Son of Telamon & Periboea; cousin of Achilles.

nodes.name: Teucer (Son of Telamon & Trojan Princess Hesione; Founder of Salamis in Cyprus)
nodes.role: Master Archer & Founder of Cypriot Salamis
nodes.notes: Half-brother of Ajax and nephew of King Priam of Troy through mother Hesione.

nodes.name: King Peleus of Phthia (Son of Aeacus; Father of Achilles)
nodes.notes: Wed Nereid Thetis in the presence of all the Olympians.

nodes.name: Nereid Thetis (Daughter of Nereus & Doris; Mother of Achilles)
nodes.notes: Dipped infant Achilles in the Styx and commissioned Hephaestus's armor.

nodes.name: King Neoptolemus / Pyrrhus of Epirus (Son of Achilles; Ancestor of Olympias!)
nodes.era: Apollodorus Epit. V.10, VI.12; Plutarch Pyrrhus 1
nodes.role: Founder of Molossian Royal Line of Epirus
nodes.notes: Son of Achilles & Deidamia; founded the Aeacid Molossian dynasty of Epirus leading to Olympias & King Pyrrhus.

nodes.name: Queen Olympias of Epirus (Daughter of Neoptolemus I of Epirus; Mother of Alexander!)
nodes.role: Molossian Princess & Mother of Alexander the Great
nodes.notes: Claimed direct descent from Achilles's son Neoptolemus; wed King Philip II of Macedon and bore Alexander the Great.

nodes.name: King Cecrops I of Athens (1st King of Attica; Eusebius 1556 BCE Trad.)
nodes.notes: Judged the contest between Athena & Poseidon for Attica.

nodes.name: King Erechtheus of Athens (Father of Creusa & Orithyia)
nodes.notes: Son of Pandion I; father of Creusa (mother of Ion!) and Cecrops II.

nodes.name: King Aegeus of Athens (Father of Theseus, Apollodorus III.xv.5)
nodes.notes: Wed Aethra (daughter of King Pittheus of Troezen) and fathered Theseus.

nodes.name: King Theseus of Athens (Slayer of the Minotaur; Son of Aegeus & Aethra)
nodes.notes: Slew the Cretan Minotaur, united Attica, wed Ariadne & Phaedra, and fathered Hippolytus, Acamas & Demophon.

nodes.name: King Tantalus of Lydia / Sipylus (Father of Pelops & Niobe)
nodes.role: Anatolian Founder of the Pelopid House
nodes.notes: Father of Pelops (Peloponnese) and Niobe.

nodes.name: Queen Niobe of Thebes (Daughter of Tantalus; Wife of Amphion)
nodes.role: Queen of Thebes Weeping on Mt. Sipylus
nodes.notes: Boasted over Leto, bringing grief upon Thebes.

nodes.name: Thyestes (Son of Pelops; Rival Brother of Atreus)
nodes.notes: Father of Aegisthus.

nodes.name: Aegisthus (Son of Thyestes; Slain by Orestes)
nodes.notes: Slain by Orestes after plotting Agamemnon's death.

nodes.name: King Orestes of Mycenae & Sparta (Son of Agamemnon; Father of Tisamenus)
nodes.role: Heir of Atreids Who United Mycenae & Sparta
nodes.notes: Married cousin Hermione (daughter of Menelaus & Helen) and fathered Tisamenus.

nodes.name: Princess Electra (Daughter of Agamemnon & Clytemnestra)
nodes.notes: Protected young Orestes; later wed Pylades.

nodes.name: Iphigenia (Eldest Daughter of Agamemnon; Priestess at Tauris)
nodes.notes: Carried by Artemis to Tauris before reuniting with Orestes.

nodes.name: Paris / Alexander of Troy (Son of Priam & Hecuba)
nodes.notes: Son of King Priam & Hecuba; awarded the golden apple to Aphrodite.

nodes.name: Prince Hector of Troy (Champion of Troy; Husband of Andromache)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Priam & Hecuba; slain outside Troy's gates by Achilles.

nodes.name: Princess Cassandra of Troy (Prophetess Daughter of Priam & Hecuba)
nodes.notes: Gifted true prophecy never believed.

nodes.name: Prince Helenus of Troy (Prophet Twin of Cassandra; King in Epirus)
nodes.role: Trojan Seer Who Wed Andromache in Epirus
nodes.notes: Welcomed Aeneas at Buthrotum in Epirus.

nodes.name: Princess Creusa of Troy (Daughter of Priam; 1st Wife of Aeneas & Mother of Ascanius)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Priam & Hecuba; mother of Ascanius/Iulus by Aeneas.
